divergences.upstreamResult: Action callbacks receive React synthetic mouse events.
divergences.octaneResult: Action callbacks receive native DOM MouseEvent objects.
divergences.rationale: Octane uses delegated native DOM events rather than React's synthetic event layer.
divergences.consumerImpact: Callbacks observe native event identity and lifecycle semantics.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Type action callbacks against the exported ActionEvent native-event contract.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if Octane introduces React-compatible synthetic events.

divergences.upstreamResult: React exposes the Toaster ref through forwardRef.
divergences.octaneResult: Toaster accepts ref as an ordinary component prop and forwards it to the host section.
divergences.rationale: Octane components do not require React's forwardRef wrapper.
divergences.consumerImpact: Consumers pass ref normally without relying on a forwardRef component identity.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Pass the host ref through the Toaster ref prop.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if Octane adopts a distinct ref-wrapper contract.

divergences.upstreamResult: Version 2.0.7 reads document.hidden during render behind its client boundary.
divergences.octaneResult: The initial visibility read is guarded when document is unavailable during server rendering.
divergences.rationale: Octane executes the Toaster component in its server runtime without an RSC client boundary.
divergences.consumerImpact: Toaster can render an accessible empty host without browser globals.
divergences.migrationGuidance: No consumer action is required; preserve the guard when syncing upstream.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if upstream becomes server-safe or Octane adds an equivalent client boundary.
